## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`), n = +1.0 → +3.24×10¹², B 0.3 → 10 T uniform-1/B

> **05:26** · landau-fan-vti electron side, D = 0: n = +1.0 to +3.24e12 (48 pts) fast x B 0.3 to 10 T two-segment uniform-1/B (159 rows) slow; sr1 100 uV, fast\_delay 2.0 s; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~11:56** (≈6h30m)

**Why this fan, from the spot checks (runs 6/7, read from the TSVs).** Run 6 (electron, n_cal = +3.2×10¹²) resolves a light tone at **7.1 T** persisting to the record's low edge (censored at 0.3 T, SNR 40), and heavy content onsetting at 1.4–1.9 T at **22.3 T** and **29.4 T**. 7.1 + 22.3 = 29.4, and the raw Rxx minima at 6.0 / 7.2 T are ν = 20 / 16 for n ≈ 2.85×10¹² — i.e. the density scale is ≈ 0.89 of the run-5 calibration and 29.4 T *is* F_L there. That is the ABAB template (model at 2.85: 6.2 / 23.3 T) with the symmetry-allowed breakdown sum at F_L — but a singleton-at-F_L reading (ABCA at scale 0.89 plus unexplained tones) is not yet excluded, and the F_L-tone position moves with the FFT window (29.4 vs 33.3 T at δF = 6.7 T): a fork the F(n) trajectory resolves. Run 7 (hole, n_cal = −1.2×10¹²) shows 6.6–7.0 T + 12.3 T (= F_L) — the near-CNP hole regime where the ABAB pair (model 5.9 / 6.5 T) is unresolvable at δF = 0.77 T; the hole side cannot exceed |n| = 1.27 inside the validators, so it is non-discriminating by design. **Electron side it is.**

**Design (investigation Step 4; `landau-fan` step 1 checks).** Fast axis: paired n-line at D = 0 (run-5 cal, D_offset −0.013), **n = 1.0 → 3.24×10¹², 48 pts** (Δn = 0.048 — the ray-Nyquist floor at 1 T is 0.048; n_max is the TG limit: V_tg = 0.995 V). Slow axis: **two-segment uniform-1/B**, 0.3 → 1.2 T at Δ(1/B) = 0.030 (85 rows; only the light tone lives there — heavy onset ≥ 1.36 T at the highest n; alias edge 16.7 T clears the 7.6 T light tone and its 2nd harmonic) and 1.2 → 10 T at Δ(1/B) = 0.0100 (75 rows; ⅓-Nyquist on F_L(3.24) = 33.5 T). **159 rows.** Resolution: light tone δF = 0.31 T (0.3–10 T) — tracks the ABAB light branch's dive (model 7.3 → 3.6 → 0.6 T from n = 3.2 → 2 → 1) vs an ABCB Dirac partner; heavy tones δF ≈ 2.3 T (onset 1.9 T) — separates ABAB-heavy from F_L only at n ≳ 2.5 (split 5–7 T), which is why n_max sits at the limit; the partition test f₁ + f₂ = F_L(n) across all 48 columns is the algebraic backbone. Dwell: `fast_delay = 2.0` s = 6.7 τ (τ = 0.3 s at 24 dB/oct → 90 % settled; the run-5 gatemap's 1.0 s was a slope read). Sensitivity **100 µV = 10 kΩ FS**: worst corner is n = 1.0 × 10 T (R(1.0, 0 T) = 117 Ω from run 5; the spot checks peaked at 576 Ω at 10 T) — 17× headroom over the largest observed R, at 0.37 Ω/LSB (quantization measured on run 6). If the lowest-n columns still rail above ~9 T, their FFT windows truncate (`r_full_scale`) and the light-tone information at low B is untouched.

**Price (calibrated on run 5: 1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1.0, 5.8 s row turnaround; run 6: 3.1 s per field set).** 2.10 s/pt × 48 + ~9 s = 110 s/row × 159 = 4.8 h grid + 9.7 T traverse 1.2 h = 6.0 h; realistic **≈ 6.5 h**, ending at **10 T** with the gates at (n = 3.24, D = 0) — the next step (LK mass split or a hole-side ride-down) starts there. Magnet is at 0 T now: the fan starts where it sits.

**Checkpoints (E1, self-driven):** (1) first 3 rows (~10 min): R levels vs 10 kΩ FS, gate currents at baseline, both gates tracking the n-line; (2) row 85 / 1.2 T (~2.7 h): partial per-column FFT of the light tone across n — does F_light(n) fall toward zero with decreasing n (ABAB) or stay linear-ish (Dirac partner)?; (3) ~4 T (~4.8 h): heavy tones emerging per column, partition sum vs F_L(n); abort at any point on a rail, leakage, or a non-tracking gate. **Hedge on the page:** the run-5 map carries a second CNP ridge (region B, electron-doped by 0.43×10¹² relative to region A) — a mosaic/contact-doping candidate; a second tone family offset in n by that amount is the signature to look for in the per-column FFTs.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`): electron side, D = 0, n = +1.0 -> +3.24e12 (48 pts) fast; B 0.3 -> 10 T two-segment uniform-1/B (159 rows) slow ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_N, N_LO, N_HI, D0 = 48, 1.0, 3.24, 0.0            # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm; n_max = TG limit (Vtg 0.995 V)
ns = np.linspace(N_LO, N_HI, N_N); Ds = D0 * np.ones_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"n-line: n = {N_LO:+.2f} -> {N_HI:+.2f}e12 ({N_N} pts, dn {ns[1]-ns[0]:.4f}e12) at D = {D0:+.2f}; "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V; "
      f"roundtrip end n,D = {calc_nD(Vtgs[-1], Vbgs[-1], CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0.3 T from rest), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- slow field axis: two-segment uniform-1/B, ascending (magnet at rest at 0 T; ends at 10 T for the next step)
F_MAX = 4.135667e-15 / 4 * N_HI * 1e16                       # F_L at n_max = 33.5 T
def _seg(b0, b1, dinv):
    return field_invB(b0, b1, int(np.ceil(abs(1 / b0 - 1 / b1) / dinv)) + 1)
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((_seg(0.3, 1.2, 0.030), _seg(1.2, 10.0, 1 / (3 * F_MAX)))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0 and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.0, 1.0      # 6.7 tau at tau = 0.3 s / 24 dB (90 % settled); magnet set already blocks + 3 s settle
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange mid-fan): 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA; worst corner n = 1.0 x 10 T.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} rows, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T (d(1/B) 0.030 to 1.2 T, {1/(3*F_MAX):.4f} above); "
      f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; drive {sr1.amplitude()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron: D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm, n = {N_LO:+.2f} to {N_HI:+.2f}e12 ({N_N} pts) fast, B {B_vec[0]} to {B_vec[-1]} T "
                  f"two-segment uniform-1/B ({len(B_vec)} rows) slow; run-5 cal; sr1 100 uV; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm, n = {N_LO:+.2f} to {N_HI:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 ({N_N} pts, paired TG/BG n-line), B = {B_vec[0]} to {B_vec[-1]} T '
              f'({len(B_vec)} rows: d(1/B) = 0.030 /T for 0.3-1.2 T, {1/(3*F_MAX):.4f} /T for 1.2-10 T); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s; sr1 100 uV')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg, Vbg (fast pair), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
# gates stay at the last n-line point; field stays at 10 T (next step rides it) — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")

Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
